maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable spices, seasonings, condiments and flavors that are used up; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by grocery consumers, retailers, restaurants and food manufacturers buying spices, sauces and flavors; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its brands (McCormick, Frank's, Cholula) and flavor sales, with only occasional acquisitions like FONA and Cholula.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer spices and condiments are easily swapped by shoppers; Flavor Solutions custom flavors have some stickiness but are the smaller segment.

notes: Flavor Solutions custom flavors for food manufacturers may be stickier, but the consumer segment is larger.
